# Trolley

> Global payment infrastructure platform enabling automated payouts, tax compliance, and workflow automation for businesses paying contractors, creators, and suppliers worldwide.

Trolley provides API-driven payout automation, ERP integrations, and tax form management solutions. The platform serves companies like SoundCloud, Envato, and Tickeri, offering SDKs and app integrations with tools like Expensify and Google Sheets.

## Key Topics

- Payout Automation
- Global Payments
- Tax Compliance & Forms
- Trolley API
- ERP Integration
- Workflow Automation
- Software Development Kits (SDKs)
- Royalty Payments
- Contractor Payments
- Invoice Management
- Expensify Integration
- Application Integrations
- Payment Infrastructure
- Cross-border Payouts
